items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I was handling Randy Crawford, and her contract came up for Warner Bros.

ctx.x: When I was handling Randy Crawford, and her contract came up for Warner Bros., a lawyer said to me, “This is a black contract. This is a contract for a black artist.” When you have a lawyer who works with Warner Bros., and you get that – yeah.
Today you have artists like Dianna Reeves and – who else? – Cassandra Wilson.
